openQuestions: Updated existing assertions (intent kept): task-notify.test.ts failed title 'Task stopped' -> 'Engram: Stopped'; task-closing.test.ts noticeText titles -> 'Engram: 다 했어요' / 'Engram: Done' / 'Engram: 멈췄어요'.
The away item is kind 'system' with key 'away', not a new kind: NoticesDto.kind lives in shared/ipc-types-3.ts, which is not an allowed file.

Previous findings: a running or queued task updated during the absence now triggers the summary by itself; a scheduled run hides only its own task (matched by the run's time window on that bot, using the new NoticeItem.began written by runPrompt), not the whole bot.

A scheduled notice written before this change has no 'began', so a run that finished before the upgrade is not matched; a manual task that changes on the same bot inside a scheduled run's window is treated as that run's task.

Not covered: quit and relaunch during an absence loses the unfocused start time (memory only); a locked screen with Engram focused sends no blur; milestones only for members hired by the lead; not verified in the running app, unit tests only.
